name: qrx
description: Official QRX MCP server: turn a text prompt and a link into an artistic, branded QR code, checked to scan before it is returned. Codes use hosted qrx.to short links.

QRX_API_KEY.description: QRX API key for local stdio or bearer authentication, created at https://qrx.codes/developers with a free account. Never commit your key.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP. Use an OAuth-capable MCP client and sign in to QRX.

http-api-key.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP using a QRX API key instead of OAuth.

npm.description: Local stdio bridge to the hosted server. Requires Node.js 18+.

examples.title: Make a code
examples.description: Generate an art QR code for a link
examples.prompt: Make a QR code for https://example.com/menu that looks like a watercolour café street.

examples.description: List the codes on your account
